newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X says Busang geologist in accident.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X says Busang geologist in accident.

text.p: Canadian gold prospector Bre-X Minerals Ltd said on Wednesday that Michael de Guzman, chief geologist at the Busang gold site in Indonesia, was involved in a helicopter accident.
"It is with great sadness that we have to announce that Mike de Guzman...fell approximately 800 feet from a helicopter as he was returning to the mine site..." Bre-X said in a statement.
The Busang property is located in East Kalimantan province on Borneo Island, Indonesia. Medical and military personnel were searching the area, Bre-X said.
"There is an extensive search and rescue operation going on and we have no confirmation of anything beyond that," Bre-X spokesman Richard Wool said in a telephone interview.
Bre-X Vice-Chairman John Felderhof, who is in North America, would return immediately to Indonesia, the company said.
